# LanguageTool

> > LanguageTool is an AI-powered grammar checker and writing assistant supporting 30+ languages with browser extensions, desktop apps, and API integration.

LanguageTool provides free and premium multilingual grammar checking, paraphrasing, and writing assistance across web, desktop, and email platforms. The service offers enterprise solutions with GDPR compliance and integrates with popular productivity tools like Microsoft Word, Google Docs, and Gmail.

## Key Topics

- AI grammar checker
- Multilingual support
- Paraphrasing tool
- Browser extensions
- Desktop applications
- Microsoft Word integration
- Google Docs add-on
- Gmail integration
- Writing assistant
- API documentation
- Premium subscription
- Enterprise/Business solutions
- GDPR compliance
- Spell checker
- Style guide

## Core Products

- [Free AI Grammar Checker - LanguageTool](https://languagetool.org): LanguageTool homepage: AI-powered grammar checker for 30+ languages
- [Premium - LanguageTool](https://languagetool.org/premium): Premium subscription page with enhanced grammar and style features
- [AI Paraphrasing Tool | Free Paraphraser - LanguageTool](https://languagetool.org/paraphrasing-tool): LanguageTool's free AI paraphrasing tool for text rewriting
- [LanguageTool for Businesses - LanguageTool](https://languagetool.org/business): Enterprise solution with team accounts and GDPR compliance

- [Grammar Checker for Gmail - LanguageTool](https://languagetool.org/google-mail): Gmail integration for LanguageTool grammar checking
- [Grammar Checker for Apple Mail - LanguageTool](https://languagetool.org/apple-mail): Apple Mail integration for macOS grammar checking
